text: Hey Alberto - so yes they normally make the decision on the day, but it can depend on a few things - including how well you did in the interview and the clerk's impression of your relationship, as well as just seniority of the clerk (if they are a new PIBA staff member, they might have to have their decision reviewed by a manager or a senior colleague). If it's the latter case, it shouldn't usually be a long wait. We had our B1 granted on the day of the interview :)
